title: Investment or crypto pitch
summary: A pitch promises returns and pressures you to transfer money or install tools.
scenario: The promoter uses scarcity, guaranteed returns, or testimonials to avoid careful review.
warning_signs: Requests to move money to a new wallet or platform
safe_actions: Do not transfer funds while the offer is unverified
Verify the firm and destination independently using trusted records
Avoid sharing wallet recovery phrases or remote access
recovery_guidance: Secure accounts and preserve transaction hashes or receipts
reporting_guidance: Keep promotional messages and transaction records
Use a reporting route only after checking its source
prevention_tips: Returns are not guaranteed by a message or dashboard
Do not let a promoter control your device or wallet
false_positive_notes: A genuine investment can carry risk and should allow time for independent review.
